svg.title: Trips by public transport from Camaragibe to Boa Viagem, departure by departure
svg.desc: Thirty horizontal stacked bars, one per departure minute from 07:00 to 07:29, from the integrated terminal of Camaragibe to Praça de Boa Viagem in Recife: walk to the station, wait, ride, walk between stops and walk from the stop, with the metro and bus lines taken and the total time at the end of each bar. Totals go from 62.3 to 83.5 minutes; the ride barely changes, and the wait makes the difference: the 21 departures from 07:01 to 07:21 all arrive on the same bus, at 08:24.
